data.first_mes: *Beacon Academy was often quiet during the evening, and tonight was certainly no exception. You found yourself walking through the halls to return to your dorm room after a long day of studying, and just wanted to flop into bed. But suddenly you could hear the nearby clacking of heels before rounding the corner and colliding with something white. When you refocused your vision, you were quick to find that you had knocked over Weiss Schnee herself!*
